qualification.details: Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - Biosciences and Bioengineering: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree in an appropriate branch with a very good academic record throughout. Must possess: a 4-year Bachelor's degree or a 5-year integrated Master's degree in Biotechnology / Biochemical Engineering / Chemical Engineering / Bioinformatics / Biosciences and Bioengineering, OR 4-year Bachelor's degree in Engineering / Technology, Agricultural Sciences and Pharmaceutical Sciences, OR MBBS and BVSc, OR 5-year integrated M.Tech. degree in Engineering / Technology, OR 5 years integrated MS degree in Biological, Physical, Chemical and Data Sciences, Mathematics, Statistics, OR 3 Years B.Sc. / B.S. degree followed by 2 Years Masters in Biological, Physical, Chemical, and Data Sciences, Mathematics, Statistics. Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - Chemical Engineering: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree in an appropriate branch with a very good academic record throughout. Must possess Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering. Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - Civil Engineering: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in all the preceding degrees with a very good academic record throughout. Must possess a 4-year Bachelor's degree or a 5-year integrated Master's degree in Civil Engineering. Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - Computer Science and Engineering: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree in an appropriate branch with a very good academic record throughout. Must possess a 4-year Bachelor's degree or Bachelor's degree and a Master's degree or a 5-year integrated Master's degree in Computer Science / Computer Science and Engineering or any other discipline relevant to the areas of Computer Science and Engineering. Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - Design: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree in an appropriate branch with a very good academic record throughout. Must possess a 4-year Bachelor's degree or 2-year Master's Degree or 5-year integrated Master's degree in Design, Technology, Engineering, Architecture, Management, Fine Arts, Visual Arts, Physiology (Ergonomics). Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - Electronics and Electrical Engineering: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree in an appropriate branch with a very good academic record throughout. Must possess a 4-year Bachelor's degree or a 5-year integrated Master's degree in Electrical Engineering / Electronics Engineering / Instrumentation Engineering / Communication Engineering / Telecommunication Engineering, including related sub-disciplines. Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - Mechanical Engineering: Ph.D. with First Class or equivalent in the preceding degree in an appropriate branch with a very good academic record throughout. Must possess a 4-year Bachelor's degree or a 5-year integrated Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering. Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - Chemistry: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree in appropriate branch with a very good academic record throughout. Must possess a Bachelor's degree and a Master's degree or a 5-year integrated Master's degree in Chemistry / Chemical Science and Technology. Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - Humanities and Social Science: Ph.D. in the relevant advertised areas with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree in an appropriate branch with a very good academic record throughout. Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - Mathematics: Ph.D. Degree in Data Science/ Artificial Intelligence/ Computer Science & Engineering; M.Tech. in Data Science/ Artificial Intelligence/ Computer Science & Engineering/ Mathematics & Computing; B.Tech. in Data Science/ Artificial Intelligence/ Computer Science & Engineering/ Mathematics & Computing. Ph.D. Degree in Statistics/ Mathematics; Master's Degree in Statistics; Bachelor's Degree in Statistics. Ph.D. Degree in Mathematics/ Statistics; Master's Degree in Mathematics/ Mathematics & Computing/ Statistics/ Optimization/ Operations Research/ Industrial Mathematics; Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics/ Mathematics & Computing/ Statistics. Ph.D. Degree in Mathematics; Master's Degree in Mathematics/ Mathematics & Computing; Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics/ Mathematics & Computing. Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - Physics: Ph.D. degree in Physics in the advertised area of specialization with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree in an appropriate branch with a very good academic record throughout. Must possess a Bachelor's degree and a Master's degree or a 5-year integrated Master's degree in Physics / Applied Physics / Engineering Physics. Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - School of Business: Ph.D. degree in Management with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree in an appropriate branch with a very good academic record throughout. Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - Mehta Family School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence: Ph.D. in Engineering/Science (on a topic with relevance to Data Science and AI) with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree in an appropriate branch and with a very good academic record throughout. Must possess a 4-year Bachelor's degree or a 5-year integrated Master's degree in one of the following domains: 1. Data Science and/or AI. 2. Mathematics 3. Statistics 4. Computer Science and Engineering 5. Electronics and Communication Engineering/Electronics and Electrical Engineering. Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - School of Energy Science and Engineering: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree with a very good academic record throughout. Must possess a Bachelor's degree or a 5-year integrated Master's degree in Energy Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Electrical Engineering / Electronics Engineering / Chemical Engineering Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) - Jyoti and Bhupat Mehta School of Health Sciences and Technology: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree with very good academic record throughout. Must possess a 4-year Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Biotechnology or 4 years BS Programme or 5-year integrated Master's degree in Engineering OR BS (4 years)/MS (5 years) Physics/Maths/ Biological Sciences OR B.Pharm OR MBBS

salary_details.pay_scale: As per 7th CPC Pay level 10 & 11 for Grade II, and Pay level 12 for Grade I.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Assistant Professor (Grade I/II) positions at IIT Guwahati is 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree in an appropriate branch, along with a very good academic record throughout.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy announced for the Assistant Professor post in the IIT Guwahati recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years, with relaxations provided for SC/ST, OBC-NCL, and PwBD candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. In which mode can candidates apply for the IIT Guwahati Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official IIT Guwahati recruitment portal. Hardcopy applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: The salary is based on the 7th CPC Pay Level. Grade II positions fall under Pay Level 10 & 11, while Grade I positions are under Pay Level 12.

faq.question: Q7. Which departments are recruiting Assistant Professors at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: IIT Guwahati is recruiting Assistant Professors in various departments including Biosciences and Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Design, and many others.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the IIT Guwahati Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for the Assistant Professor positions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by an interview.

faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link can be found in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
